QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the barrier. With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))`, so the compiler cannot see through the value.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier preventing the compiler from seeing the value, and it puts the definitions in `library/constant_time_impl.h`. It names that file as the location of the API definitions but doesn't tie that to this function explicitly. The two statements together carry the item.
